title: Arrays are shared, not copied
prompt: Earlier you saw that a number passed to a function is a copy. Arrays are different. Write `add_item`, which takes an array and appends 99 to it, returning nothing. In solve, call add_item(items) and then return items. Has the original changed?
starter:
func solve(items: Array) -> Array:
	return items
hint: The helper does not need to return anything: both names point at the same array, so changes made through one show up in the other.
